name.full: Liraz Tann of the Lower Veins

epithet: who built a door without first finding a room
mannerisms: lights candles in daylight without seeming to notice
looks past your shoulder when they answer
collects the names of streets they will not return to
voice: lilting, with an accent no one can quite place
aspiration: to build the thing they have seen
fear: the last person walking out without saying anything
wound: a doorway they watched until dark
secret: that the person they need to convince is themselves

threads.desc: who never said it and is unlikely to
whom {name} cannot quite forgive, and cannot quite stop calling
who said the right sentence at the right moment, and is unaware of any of it

backstory.origin: Liraz came up in Fracture City, of the Lower Veins. Their watch-keeper was rarely home, their smith was generous to strangers.
backstory.weight: Doors closed in this family without being slammed. The pattern of being almost-loved-and-then-left runs back further than anyone has the heart to trace.
backstory.fracture: Around their twenty-fives, the vision came. Or the obligation came. Whichever it was, Liraz could not put it down, and they have been carrying it largely alone since.
backstory.between: Between then and now, they did most of the ordinary things. They lived in a town that was theirs only in winters for a time, learned to mend their own clothes, and grew briefly close to a person whose name they will not say in mixed company.
backstory.present: These days, Liraz can be found at the watch wall most mornings. They have a book they have re-read four times that they will not throw away, and a habit of walking three blocks past where they need to go that even their oldest friends find slightly strange.
